BFA.note: Nothing stated on an authentication service.
No link to a civil register stated.
State data centres are named only as hosting the ID register; no data centre for hire stated.

facts.fact: Minister Aminata Zerbo/Sabane said the unique identifier platform was tested in a pilot that enrolled more than 16,000 people, before the mass enrolment launched on 11 November 2026.
The minister said the unique identifier system was designed by Burkinabe engineers and is hosted in the State's data centres.

BFA.note: No other public register keyed on the unique identifier is stated.

facts.fact: President Ibrahim Traore officially launched mass enrolment of the population into the unique identifier register on 11 November 2026, with 966 kits to be deployed, after a pilot enrolling over 16,000 people; the minister says it prevents multiple registrations of one citizen.
The minister said the unique identifier system is hosted in the State's data centres.
The minister said mobile teams will go to internally displaced people, elderly, disabled and detained people for the unique identifier enrolment launched on 11 November 2026.
